employees.basis: approximately 73,000 employees worldwide, including retail and part-time employees

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1, Employee Base
source.quote: As of May 31, 2026, we had approximately 73,000 employees worldwide, including retail and part-time employees.

payroll.label: annual total compensation of the median employee

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO pay ratio
source.quote: For fiscal 2026, our last completed fiscal year: • The employee identified at the median of all NIKE employees (other than our CEO) was a retail employee in the United Kingdom; • The annual total compensation of the median employee was $48,695;

notes: Employees: approximate head count at May 31, 2026, including retail and part-time staff. Payroll: the 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the July 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for fiscal 2026 is used (a retail employee in the United Kingdom; ratio 746 to 1 for CEO Elliott Hill).
